prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1381; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, with complaints of neck and back pain consistent with the mechanism of injury. Initial examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion. Neurological screening, including reflexes and sensation, was within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated on the initial evaluation. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to the patient or documented in the available history.

Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms and range of motion improved. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms with only occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise.
